name: Giant Wasp
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed skills, special senses, or languages.
appearance: A giant wasp with a narrow waist, black-and-ochre bands, long curved antennae, thin veined wings, and a tapered stinger.

sections.Printed source: D&D Basic Rules, v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 137.
sections.Actions: Sting. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one creature within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. The target then makes a DC 11 Constitution save against 10 (3d6) poison damage, taking half on a success. If the poison damage drops the target to 0 HP, the target is stable, poisoned for 1 hour even if it regains HP, and paralyzed as long as this poisoning lasts.
sections.At the table: Track piercing and poison damage separately. A stable creature makes no death saving throws while at 0 HP. While poisoned, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. Paralysis also incapacitates it, prevents movement and speech, and causes automatic failure of Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against it have advantage, and hits from within 5 ft. are critical hits.

name: Giant Wolf Spider
otherStatistics: Perception +3 and Stealth +7. Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A squat brown wolf spider with stout hairy legs, a compact oval abdomen, and a prominent central pair of dark forward-facing eyes.

sections.Printed source: D&D Basic Rules, v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 137.
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. Move over difficult surfaces, including ceilings upside down, without an ability check.
Web Sense. While touching a web, the spider pinpoints each other creature touching that same web.
Web Walker. Webbing does not slow or restrict the spider's movement.
